name: [Katagami] Someone's MCP token keeps being rejected
message:
Twenty or more MCP requests in the last hour arrived WITH a bearer token and were rejected. A fresh client discovering it needs auth sends no token at all, so these are callers who believe they are authenticated and are not.

Group by @reason to tell the cases apart:
  expired — their agent is not refreshing; a real user is locked out and probably does not know why
  signature / audience / scope — misconfigured client
  generation / grant_revoked — a deliberate sign-out taking effect, usually fine
  backend_unavailable — Temper is down; this is an outage, not a user problem

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server%20env%3Aproduction%20%40evt%3Amcp_auth_challenge%20%40has_auth%3Atrue

These counts are forgeable — anyone can present 20 garbage bearers — so read
the @reason breakdown before concluding a real user is locked out.
